summary_en: 2,100,000 shares (13.09% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 10 Aug 2026 at ceiling price ¥919/share, aggregate limit ¥2,043,300,000. Execution window 10 Aug–30 Sep 2026. Separate resolution to cancel 2,600,000 shares (14.43% of issued pre-cancellation) on 30 Oct 2026; cancellation lot includes the 2.1M shares acquired.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition and ToSTNeT-3 off-auction transaction buyback of treasury shares, and cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 7 August 2026, Daido Signal's board resolved to acquire up to 2,100,000 treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-auction transaction on 10 August 2026 at a ceiling price of ¥919/share, with an aggregate upper limit of ¥2,043,300,000. The acquisition window runs from 10 August through 30 September 2026. The shares represent 13.09% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury), calculated against the 16,044,494 shares outstanding as of 31 March 2026. The board also resolved separately to cancel 2,600,000 shares on 30 October 2026, representing 14.43% of issued shares pre-cancellation; the 2,100,000 shares acquired under this program are included in the cancellation total. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under the medium-term management plan 'PLAN2026' announced in May 2024, as part of capital-cost-aware and stock-price-aware management.
